Name: Old English in Continental Europe
Description: This event seeks to bring together scholars to exchange research, teaching practices, and resources, as well as to consider the particular opportunities and challenges of studying and teaching Old English beyond the Anglophone world.

Name: Old English Abroad lecture
Description: First Old English Abroad lecture by Professor Santiago Disalvo (Universidad Nacional de la Plata), entitled 'Awareness and References to Early Medieval English Poetry in Spanish-speaking Intellectual Circles (Late 19th and Early 20th Centuries)'

Name: 48th Symposium on Old English, Middle English and Historical Linguistics (#SOEMEHL48)
Description: Annual symposium with keynote speaker Professor Miriam Edlich-Muth (Heinrich Heine Universität Düsseldorf)

Name: 8th Old English Student Conference: Thinkers and Thanes
Description: Old English Student Conference (OESC) is a student conference organized by the Old English Student Society (KNA UJ). The event aims to gather scholars and students (BA, MA, PhD) interested in the study of Early Medieval England and offer them a comfortable space for discussion and growth. Keynote speakers: Thijs Porck (Leiden University), Monika Opalińska (University of Warsaw), Anna Cichosz (University of Lodz ) & Lindy Brady (Edge Hill University)

Name: 47th Symposium on Old English, Middle English and Historical Linguistics (#SOEMEHL47)
Description: Annual symposium with keynote speaker Lindy Brady (Edge Hill University)

Name: Joseph Bosworth & Old English Studies: Then, Now and the Future
Description: An online academic memorial event about the continuing impact of Joseph Bosworth († 27 May 1876) and his dictionary on the field of Old English Studies.
Organiser: EMERGENCE, University of St Andrews & Charles University in Prague

Name: Historical English Analysis and Research Tradition (HEART) Conference - 2
Description: The Historical English Analysis and Research Tradition (HEART) Conference aims to gather specialists in English mediaeval language, literature, and culture. It offers a platform for interdisciplinary exchange on the research methods and new interpretations of the materials dated up to 1700. Keynote speakers: Kristin Bech (University of Oslo) and Leonard Neidorf (Shenzhen University)

Name: Historical English Analysis and Research Tradition (HEART) Conference - 1
Description: The Historical English Analysis and Research Tradition (HEART) Conference aims to gather specialists in English mediaeval language, literature, and culture. It offers a platform for interdisciplinary exchange on the research methods and new interpretations of the materials dated up to 1700. Keynote speakers Jan Čermák (Charles University, Prague), Tamás Karáth (Comenius University, Bratislava and Pázmány Péter Catholic University, Budapest), Thijs Porck (Leiden University) and Jane Toswell (Western University).
